description_en: A rounded tray with shell and fillet
code:
import cadquery as cq

# === 参数 ===
width = 200       # 托盘宽度 (mm)
depth = 150       # 托盘深度 (mm)
height = 30       # 托盘高度 (mm)
wall_t = 3        # 壁厚 (mm)
corner_r = 15     # 外角圆角 (mm)
bottom_r = 5      # 内底圆角 (mm)

# === 基础体 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(width, depth, height)
    .edges("|Z").fillet(corner_r)
    .faces(">Z").shell(-wall_t)
    .edges("<Z").fillet(bottom_r)
)

show_object(result)
